sources_used: Apollo Global Management 10-K FY2025 (Item 7 MD&A segment results)

kpis.description_fr: AUM total Apollo (Credit + Equity + Real Assets). Croissance dopée par origination Athene + plateforme private credit (KPI vedette gestionnaires alternatifs).
kpis.description_en: Apollo total AUM (Credit + Equity + Real Assets). Growth driven by Athene origination + private credit platform (flagship KPI for alternative asset managers).

kpis.description_fr: Revenus récurrents de management fees (hors performance fees). Métrique clé de visibilité bénéficiaire chez les alternative managers : prévisible et adossée à l'AUM permanent.
kpis.description_en: Recurring management fee earnings (excluding performance fees). Key earnings visibility metric at alternative managers: predictable and tied to permanent AUM.
kpis._specific_to: Alt asset manager recurring core profitability

kpis.description_fr: Spread investment - cost of funds chez Athene (filiale retraite/annuités). Pilier différenciant Apollo vs concurrents (Blackstone/KKR) : capital permanent.
kpis.description_en: Investment spread minus cost of funds at Athene (retirement/annuities subsidiary). Apollo's key differentiator vs Blackstone/KKR: permanent capital.

kpis.description_fr: Volume annuel de dette originée par les plateformes Apollo (MidCap, Apollo Origination Partnership, etc.). Capacité d'alimenter Athene en actifs spread-yielding.
kpis.description_en: Annual debt originated by Apollo platforms (MidCap, Apollo Origination Partnership, etc.). Feeds Athene with spread-yielding assets.
kpis._specific_to: Apollo origination engine differentiating credit franchise

kpis.description_fr: Capital engagé non investi (private equity + credit). Indicateur de capacité de déploiement futur et de fee-earning AUM en attente d'activation.
kpis.description_en: Committed but uninvested capital (private equity + credit). Indicates future deployment capacity and dormant fee-earning AUM.
